title: galeopsis ladanum subsp. filholiana
intro: Galeopsis ladanum subsp. filholiana, commonly known as French galeopsis, is a subspecies of the Galeopsis ladanum plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional European folk medicine. The health benefits of French galeopsis include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it beneficial for treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of French galeopsis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
